name: Rubescent-Crucible
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near an ancient meteor crater.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
the quarantine zone was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
